The gray N can be regarded as composed of three non-overlapping parts: a vertical gray long strip on the left, a vertical gray long strip on the right, and a slanted gray parallelogram long strip in the middle. Each small square has side length 1. Reasoning: The left vertical strip in the figure is 1 small square wide and 6 small squares high, so its area is 1 × 6 = 6. The right vertical strip is likewise 1 wide and 6 high, so its area is also 6. The middle slanted strip is a parallelogram; its upper side has horizontal width of 1 small square, and its vertical height is 6 small squares, so its area is 1 × 6 = 6. Adding the three parts, the area of the letter N is 6 + 6 + 6 = 18.
